role: XCTest suite for MorningProcessingService: overnight processing end-to-end through real analysis components with MockHealthKitService, same-night merge (archive-seeded), merge-gap helpers, sleep poll with no data, recovery score range, and composite-point source selection.
types: MorningProcessingServiceTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase building a fresh MorningProcessingService graph per test
state: mem:NSTimeZone.default (set to UTC for the class, restored in class tearDown)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers build a private SessionArchive, MockHealthKitService, WindowSelector, ArtifactDetector, Verification, BaselineTracker, RawRRBackup; lazy HRVAnalysisPipeline and MorningProcessingService; fixedSessionStart = 2100-01-01T00:00Z.

flags.text: RawRRBackup() is the shared production backup store; processOvernightData writes real backup files there for each processed session. tearDown discards only ids recorded by createBaseSession, so the archived 'existingSession' in the merge test never goes through the backup step and nothing leaks, but the suite shares the store with the app host while running.

BaselineTracker() (stored property) loads HRVBaseline.json from the shared App Group container (AppConfig.sharedContainerURL), so the baseline used for window ranking, the insufficient-data gate and scoring during every processOvernightData test is the test host's real baseline history, not a test-controlled one; results can differ between a clean simulator and one with app data.

branches.effect: restores NSTimeZone.default to it; otherwise leaves the default as is
